summary: Frontend-only retest completed for iteration 21 fixes. Fresh deep-links for all requested chapters now consistently activate correct HUD and full-viewport framing on desktop and mobile; post-Legacy navigation overlap/lag issue was not reproducible.
action_items: No blocking frontend issues found in this retest scope.
Optional: run one additional soak test (multi-minute continuous route cycling) before release lock.
critical_code_review_comments: Iteration 21 hash/activation fixes appear effective: active chapter class, HUD label, and viewport framing remained synchronized in all tested deep-links.
No console error selectors, horizontal overflow, blank viewport, or transformed-hit-area click failures were observed in this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) both passed direct fresh deep-links for legacy/timeline/cars/gallery/records/milestones/tracks/moment/quotes/victories/footer. Active chapter bounding boxes were full viewport; inactive remained minimized. Timeline arrows+keyboard, gallery prev/next, quote prev/next, and victory year filter worked. Continuous navigation after Legacy showed no freezes, overlap, or severe lag.
rca of the issue: Previously reported race/desync between initial hash activation and chapter transform state appears mitigated by iteration 21 changes (initial hash honoring post-Lenis setup, __spatialGo fallback, stronger active selector specificity, and active transform transition removal).
